parsed.explanation: The division sits under a parent regime with real universal exposures: passport sex-marker restrictions with documented confiscations/stranding, visa 'reasonable doubt' refusal guidance with fraud/misrepresentation findings, birth-sex facility rules in many units, and documented custody harms — but also functioning courts, a national gender-identity hate-crime statute, marriage recognition, active litigation, and accepting regions. The division adds its own hostile layer: a March 2025 birth-sex multi-occupancy facility ban applying to every visitor (tier-1 universal exposure, unremedied), a criminal trespass trigger for facility use in some circumstances, no state hate-crime or nondiscrimination statute, sports and care bans, and a 'worst units' national risk rating. No evidence of organised arrests for presentation; same-sex conduct legal since 1977; local ordinances in three cities. This places it slightly below the parent average, around 0.45-A minus: same-tier facility rule plus an added criminal offence and worse institutional climate.
